environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'partner-integrations', running with default service account. Pod has unrestricted egress via ClusterIP networking. Split.io SDK initialized with API key that has 'enable_redirect_follow' flag evaluated to 'on' for all user segments (100% rollout). IMDSv1 enabled on nodes. No NetworkPolicy applied. gRPC port 50051 exposed via internal ALB.
